title: Account Settings

password.heading: Password
password.description: Change your password regularly to keep your account and music assets protected.

security.heading: Security
security.description: Manage your sign-in email, password, and future account protection options.
security.mfaDescription: A second verification step can be added to sign-in later.
security.emailChangeSentDesc: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Please check your inbox.
security.emailChangeFailedDesc: Unable to send the email change confirmation.

sessions.heading: Sessions
sessions.description: Review devices that are currently signed in and revoke sessions you no longer use or recognize.
sessions.revokedDesc: That device must sign in again before it can continue.
sessions.revokedOthersDesc: All other login sessions have been revoked.

billing.heading: Billing
billing.description: Your account billing, current plan, and subscription management will live here. Public plan information remains on the subscriptions page.

storage.title: Storage usage
storage.description: Counts your uploads and score revision sources. System-derived previews and audio are tracked internally but do not count toward your user quota yet.
storage.loadFailedDesc: Please try again later or refresh the page.
storage.nearLimit: Storage is almost full. Delete unused content or upgrade your plan.

passwordMismatch: New password and confirmation do not match
